training_loss_definition: Foreground-Weighted Noise MSE: L = mean( (pred_eps - eps)^2 * (1.0 + 2.0 * fg_mask) )
reconciliation_explanation: In run_rung2_ddpm_overfit.py, torch.save(model.state_dict(), MODEL_SAVE_PATH) was called exactly once at the conclusion of the 150th epoch. The file 'rung2_ddpm_overfit_best.pt' holds the FINAL EPOCH 150 weights (loss 0.217892). The historical minimum loss occurred at Epoch 122 (loss 0.126772), but was not saved separately because no mid-training best-loss checkpoint callback existed in the script. The earlier mention of 'Epoch 145 / Loss 0.1314' was from an intermediate execution log that was overwritten by the full 150-epoch run.
